source: In PHP and Blade files, the preset reads {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} and {5}. Laravel writes the keys of a nested file with a slash. The preset turns each slash into a dot:
text: 在 PHP 和 Blade 文件中，该预设会读取 {0}、{1}、{2}、{3}、{4} 和 {5}。Laravel 使用斜杠来写嵌套文件的键。该预设会将每个斜杠转换为点：
